name: Beat FX Tab
author: b.sr
summary: Keep the Beat FX panel closed and still see it all: effect, beat value and on/off, right on the collapsed tab.
description:
Want your screen space back for beat and phrase matching, without losing sight of your Beat FX? On the 2 DECK waveform views, the collapsed BEAT FX tab shows the selected effect and its beat value (LENGTH % for REVERB, X-PAD while you play it on the X-PAD). Off: grey, with the name underlined in the effect's X-PAD colour. On: the whole tab lights up in that colour. Tap the tab as usual to open the stock panel.

Display only: it reads the mixer's Beat FX report and where you touch, and changes nothing. No hooks, no files, no network. Not tested with Drum Roll or other mods that use the X-PAD.
